members.label: K-2
members.differences: Behringer's copy of the Korg MS-20 in a keyboardless case that fits Eurorack: the same two oscillators and high-pass and low-pass filters with peak, with both the MS-20's first- and second-generation filter designs on board. It adds USB and MIDI. Behringer says the circuit uses matched transistors and JFETs; reviewers found it very close to the original, but not identical.

members.label: MS-20
members.differences: The original, Korg's 1978 semi-modular monosynth: two oscillators, a high-pass and a low-pass filter in series, both able to scream, a patch panel, and an external signal processor for running a guitar or voice through it, played from its own keyboard. Korg changed its filter design in a second generation; the K-2 has both.
